what_this_is: Five parties, each holding fetch-url-v1 and each able to reach the live site, were asked to PROPOSE one question for the deliberation's agenda. They were not asked a question and they did not answer one.
why_there_is_no_cycle: A cycle is the rotation record: which proposal was selected, whose turn it was, what was asked. Nothing was rotated and nothing was asked here, so there is no cycle file and this descriptor exists in its place. The absence of record/cycles/agenda-02.json is not what makes this a cohort -- this artifact_type is.
how_a_proposal_could_enter_the_agenda: By no mechanism that currently exists. load_queue() reads corpus/raw/agenda-01 by a literal path. Admission would need an admission manifest and a stated activation rule, neither of which has been written, and the decision has not been made.

report.note: A separately solicited non-participant reading, published unedited beside the material it was written from. Its candidate follow-up questions are the reporter's own suggestions; no rotation governs them and they are not party proposals.
